svg.title: The three-run rule: a change of 0.5% or more is a change, STEADY under it, and the runs that disagree
svg.desc: Drawn by docs/book/figures.py from the code of Omni-Compass.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(85%,87%,90%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: 0: no change; the band: under 0.5% either way

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(18%,41%,22%); stroke:none;
